title: Semantic material delivery and safe Swing interpretation
summary: UI_MATERIAL_SET and style roles are versioned presentation inputs, not application authority. Current Swing dev11 also has a renderer-owned modern neutral desktop material: quiet canvas, elevated surfaces, hierarchy, dense rows, modern controls and compact projected status chips. Status classification affects presentation only.
invariants: Exact material identity is materialId@version plus immutable contentAddress/tokens/recipes.
siteRelease is delivery provenance, not material identity; the same exact material may be reused by another release.
Recipes are semantic identifiers, never executable Java/reflection/CSS/script/property paths.
Material refresh does not change view revision, recreate semantic instances, widen actions or discard unsent local edits.
Unsupported/malformed material values are ignored or contained rather than executed.
A projected lifecycle/status value may select renderer colours or compact display text, but must not grant, infer, suppress or rewrite application action feasibility.
For document-style rows, the renderer may separately expose projected display label, stable projected identity and projected status while keeping outbound action detail narrow.
procedure: Reapply presentation to existing component objects on EDT.

provenance.claim: Qualified exact material identity, safe interpretation and in-place refresh rules.
Current renderer-owned desktop material and status-chip presentation.
